name: HC11d: Active on ART who had a clinical contact during the reporting quarter
description: Counts unique ART patients who had at least one documented ART clinical encounter during the reporting quarter. The clinical contact itself satisfies the encounter-based active-on-ART condition.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY);
